newRules: The raw [Cash] KillReward value is paid as a flat credit amount to the player for each destroyed sector target. The units and formula of [Cash] (ShareRadius 0, SharePercent 0, PercentOfKiller 100, PercentOfTarget 1000) and [Bounty] are undecoded and not applied.
Sector targets are NEW practice targets, not original NPCs. Each target pays once per sector instance; targets come back when the sector is reset or the client relaunches.
Destroying a target drops nothing (original drop rules are open).
